_comment: Verium Miner configuration. Edit 'user' (and optionally 'pass'), then run the miner with no arguments. Tip: run `cpuminer --setup` to generate this interactively.
_threads: 0 = auto (recommended): picks threads from P-cores, RAM and cache.
_profile: 'background' keeps the machine responsive; 'dedicated' raises CPU priority for mining-only rigs.
_log-file: Optional: append plain-text logs to this path for headless/service runs, e.g. "/var/log/veriumminer/miner.log".
